title: Define durable OS run state reconciliation
purpose: Make AgentOS recover OS operation from durable RunStore, AuditJournal, rollback store and ecosystem active state.
scope: Define truth precedence between RunStore, AuditJournal and active artifact state.
Define recovery classes and operator projection.
Define no-model-replay rule for recovery authority.
implementation_steps: Map unfinished effects and active artifacts to recovery outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Recovery source is RunStore + AuditJournal + active artifact state.
Half-committed effects are never silently considered complete.
Model replay is not an authority.
failure_modes: RollbackPending state is lost after restart.
